categories.name: PART_OF_WHOLE
categories.definition: One entity is a smaller, integral component or sub-division of a larger entity.

categories.name: LOCATED_IN
categories.definition: One entity is physically contained within the geographical boundaries or physical space of another entity.

categories.name: CREATOR_OF
categories.definition: One entity is the primary individual or group responsible for originating a creative work, product, or structure.

categories.name: OWNER_OPERATOR_MANAGER
categories.definition: One entity holds ownership, operational control, or management responsibility over another entity.

categories.name: CLASSIFICATION_TYPE
categories.definition: One entity describes the nature, classification, genre, or defining attribute of another entity.

categories.name: MEMBER_PARTICIPANT
categories.definition: One entity is an individual or group belonging to an organization, team, or actively involved in an event.

categories.name: RELATIONSHIP_ASSOCIATION
categories.definition: A direct personal, familial, or conceptual link exists between two entities, such as kinship, equivalence, or a strong non-hierarchical connection.

categories.name: WORK_INTERNAL_ELEMENT
categories.definition: One entity is a fictional character, a specific part, or an internal element within a creative work.

categories.name: AWARD_DESIGNATION
categories.definition: One entity is an official recognition, honor, or formal status granted to another entity.

categories.name: TIME_EVENT
categories.definition: One entity represents a specific time or duration during which an event occurred or an action took place.

categories.name: ACTIVITY_PERFORMED
categories.definition: One entity represents an action or activity that is carried out by or directly involves the other entity.
